_doc: Baseline for tests/CorpusJsonReadLint.Tests.ps1 (t/4366 AC3). Each key is '<repo-relative file>::<function>' for a function that reads with bare ConvertFrom-Json and writes the object back with ConvertTo-Json. A new hit fails the lint; an entry no longer found is a ratchet-down note (delete it). Every entry needs a reason and the ticket that owns it.
